verdict.rationale: Gide has a dedicated Data Protection practice page. It documents assisting clients with personal data processing and compliance with the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act, including CNIL sanctions proceedings. It also runs a separate IT, Digital & Cybersecurity practice. Missing for 10: independent corroboration (rankings or client references) for the data-protection practice, and evidence of coverage for non-EU regimes such as CCPA or DPDP or of detailed cyber-incident counsel.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: We assist our clients with the implementation of personal data processing and ensure compliance with the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
ensure compliance with the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act of 6 January 1978
